text_block_list.text:
The autumn series begins. The rivals have all
grown strong and gotten off to a smooth start.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Special Week!
Special Week takes a commanding victory in her autumn opener!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight, with a torrential late charge,
she blows right past all the favorites!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you're running ahead of me, I'm going to pass you! No matter if it's Suzuka-san or El-chan!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She's no longer just a cute little sister!
With unmatched fighting spirit and pure grit,
she lays claim to the title of Japan's best!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A complete victory for Grass Wonder! With rock-solid racecraft
and a mind like clear water, she gave the other racers no chance whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to do but push forward undaunted.
This autumn—I shall pursue an even greater ideal.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Among all the top Umamusume, her level of perfection stands far above the rest!
Will anyone emerge this autumn capable of tearing down this impenetrable fortress!?

Meanwhile, completely apart from the races themselves,
an extraordinary wave of excitement was sweeping through this autumn.

Yes, through a special event
conceived by El Condor Pasa.
(UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, Grass, it's finally starting!
Our special live performance as a trio!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All the singing and dance lessons we've done together.
The culmination of it all is right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right, El-chan! This stage is
the goal we've been aiming for all along!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Was that how it was~? I thought this event was supposed to just be side entertainment...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's go-o-o!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you're not even listening, are you...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today, EVERYOOOOONE!
Our three voices are gonna make your beat throb!
(UOOOOOOH!)
The close-knit, impromptu unit of El Condor Pasa, Special Week, and Grass Wonder. The live performance part of the event was a roaring success.
And—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, coming up next
is the talk show segggmmeeent!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It has already been a massive success, but I still must say it.
I have to say it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today's event was merely the opening act
for the GⅠ season that is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
There are so many big races in autumn!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And each of us has our own goal.
For El, it's the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Non-non-non, Grass. El's goal
is not the 'Japan Cup.'

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
(Chatter chatter chatter...)
"The venue stirred. Everyone had assumed El Condor Pasa's goal was the Japan Cup, but..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, allow me to ask you all right here!
What is the "World's Strongest" that El strives to be?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It means being 'number one among the world's strongest.'
However, think about it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What if, by some chance, no strong Umamusume
enter the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you win there, can you truly be called the world's strongest?
No! Absolutely not."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For El to become the world's strongest,
those around El must be strong too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest means the King of Kings!
Everyone around must be royalty as well, yeeeees!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, El is surrounded by wonderful amigas.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Both Spe-chan and Grass are among the strongest
Umamusume in the country, yes. However...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Not enough yet! Neither for you two, nor for El!
We're far, far from finished!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just like today's live performance, we compete on the same stage,
join our strength together, and rise to even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All of us need to become
world-class together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After running in so many races, I realized.
The rival I need to settle things with first...
is right beside me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Spe-chan and Grass have grown stronger than ever.
Only when I surpass the two of them
can I truly take on the world!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is why El shall take flight! From this event to the Japan Cup, and then all the way to the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Only by facing both of them and winning both races will I earn the right to challenge the world on an overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And if I go on the offensive myself and win!
That is when El will become 'The World's Strongest' YEEES!"
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

An entertainer.
Her talent truly exploded in that talk.

Bringing drama into battle. That is the pro wrestling way,
and the El Condor Pasa way...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, I understand...!
Then I'll enter the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat El-chan, who beat Suzuka-san!
To become the number one horse girl in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Then I will head to—the Arima Kinen.
Every ounce of my strength, poured into one race."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, I always knew this time would come.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: When you were suffering, the reason I reached out... was for your sake, for mine, and for our future together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I respect you, but...
I won't let you take flight into the skies of the world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Carrying ambitions as vast as the azure sky, the one
who will be declared the victor—is me.
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!)

The stage has been set.
No, El Condor Pasa set it herself.
With the help of those who believe in her.

The autumn-winter GⅠ season is sure to be fierce.
As a high-level contest, and at the same time,
as top-notch entertainment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And here, the Big Three collide! Who will emerge victorious?
The "Dosanko of Guts", the "Blue Ogre of Tenacity",
or the "Indomitable Condor"?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's time for a showdoooown, both of you!!!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Oooh!
